children.desc: Thymallus tugarinae, also known as the Lower Amur grayling, is a species of freshwater fish in the salmon family.

children.name: Thymallus yaluensis
children.desc: Thymallus yaluensis, also known as Yalu grayling, is a putative species of freshwater ray-finned fish in the genus Thymallus (graylings) of the family Salmonidae.
Thymallus, commonly known as graylings, is a genus of freshwater ray-finned fish and the only genus within the subfamily Thymallinae of the family Salmonidae.
